## Description {#details}

<p>Tracking metadata reference owned by <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/metadata">Metadata</a>.</p>


<p>Similar to <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/trackingmdref">TrackingMDRef</a></em>, but it's expected to be owned by an instance of <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/metadata">Metadata</a></em>, which has the option of registering itself for callbacks to re-unique itself.</p>


<p>In particular, this is used by <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mdnode">MDNode</a></em>.</p>


<p>Definition at line 895 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/metadata-h">Metadata.h</a>.</p>
